run_passage_retrieval: run passage retrieval against a corpus using a Contriever model and Faiss index
embed_queries: embed a list of query strings into dense vectors using a Contriever model
index_encoded_data: index pre-encoded passage embeddings from pickle files into a Faiss index in batches
validate_retrieval_results: validate retrieval results by calculating top-k hit rates across questions
add_passages_to_data: add retrieved passage contexts with scores to question-answer data entries
